categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two segments: consumer electronics and new energy. Consumer electronics include customized design and production of interconnect cables (signal harnesses), signal adapters, power adapters, cleaning robots, and smart security products. The new energy segment focuses on research, production, and sales of home energy storage systems and outdoor mobile power supplies.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies in signal transmission and power supply, including USB Type-C, HDMI, DP, Thunderbolt, and GaN power products. It employs ODM and OEM manufacturing models with integrated capabilities in wire harnessing, injection molding, SMT, and assembly. The company emphasizes R&D with a strong innovation team, holding multiple industry certifications and developing proprietary algorithms and modular product designs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are global consumer electronics system manufacturers and end retailers, including well-known international brands. The products serve industries such as smart mobile communications, audio-visual equipment, personal computing, smart home, and energy storage. The company maintains a stable customer base with a focus on expanding both existing and new clients worldwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant presence in China, Vietnam, Hong Kong, Australia, South Africa, Nigeria, Europe, and North America. It has manufacturing bases in Jiangxi Province, Guangdong Province, and Vietnam, and sales networks covering Asia, Europe, and North America.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing, and assembly of electronic components and energy storage products. It integrates upstream processes like wire harnessing and injection molding but mainly serves as a manufacturer and supplier to global consumer electronics brands.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous R&D investment to maintain technological leadership in consumer electronics and new energy products. The company focuses on product innovation, expanding product lines, and enhancing global manufacturing and sales capabilities. Key R&D directions involve high-speed signal transmission, power adapters with GaN technology, smart home robotics, and advanced energy storage solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of customized consumer electronics products and new energy solutions. The company operates under ODM and OEM models, selling products under customers' brands globally. Revenue is predominantly from product sales with a high proportion of export sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in electronic signal transmission and adapter products, recognized for integrating R&D, design, precision manufacturing, and sales. It competes with other global and regional manufacturers in consumer electronics components and energy storage sectors, leveraging its global customer base and certifications to maintain competitive positioning.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.21 billion, a 16.26% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 76.7 million, a 40.45% decrease. Total assets reached RMB 3.71 billion, growing 13.52%. The company has a sizable workforce of over 8,200 employees and maintains steady growth with significant R&D investment accounting for nearly 9% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, customized product solutions with rapid R&D response and stable manufacturing processes. It differentiates through advanced technology certifications, comprehensive product management systems, and global manufacturing and sales networks. Its dual focus on consumer electronics and new energy products provides diversified growth and resilience, offering customers integrated one-stop procurement services.
